description: Asks whether each string builtin is available in the DAO query context and what it returns at ordinary and boundary inputs ($ forms, byte forms, zero and out-of-range positions, empty search, Null, non-Latin-1 characters, a lone surrogate code), each call its own SELECT. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
